law: Products are workloads. McCluster is the platform.

durable_truth.rule: Canonical durable state, identity, objectives, jobs, media, compute, communications, learning, audit and provenance live here. Do not create a second control-plane database or memory database.

public_edge.rule: Public ingress, auth, routing and API normalization only. Do not create a second Worker named mccluster-core or move durable truth into the edge.

transport_edges.authority: Same Supabase house-owner authorization and OVH Core broker; no separate identity, storage, jobs or orchestration.

execution.rule: Persistent execution, local-model inference, tool brokering, objective execution and orchestration run here. Routine deployment is outbound reconciliation from the deployment ref.

source.rule: Source and tested promotion path. main is authoritative; historical branches are not architecture authorities.

specialized_compute.rule: GPU/desktop/specialized nodes are capability workers. They do not receive Supabase service-role authority and do not become independent control planes.

operational_ontology.rule: Semantic/kinetic layer over canonical Supabase domain tables. It does not replace source-of-truth tables, the job system, objective system, memory, or policy gates.

authority.humans: Consequential authority: production deploy/rollback authorization, contracts, purchases, legal commitments and other high-impact decisions.
authority.models: Propose bounded actions through policy gates. Models do not directly merge, deploy, purchase, sign contracts or bypass authorization.
authority.products: Workloads consuming shared identity, data, capabilities and execution. Products do not invent parallel schedulers, identity systems, social graphs or control-plane databases.

forbidden_architecture: second Supabase project used as the McCluster control plane
second workflow engine or scheduler duplicating ops_agent_jobs and McCluster Core
second memory database duplicating private ai_context or canonical durable state
direct model-to-production deploy, merge, purchase or contract authority
infrastructure change path bypassing /v1/ops capability gates, the estate or the control ledger
agents, satellites or compute nodes holding their own GitHub, Cloudflare, Supabase management or OVH credentials
compute nodes holding Supabase service-role credentials
satellite products creating parallel McCluster identity namespaces
routine production deployment by arbitrary SSH checkout instead of deploy/ovh-production reconciliation
salvage_rule: Historical branches are evidence, not merge targets. Rebuild useful ideas fresh from current main while preserving current privacy, idempotency, security, deployment and authority contracts.
